description: We are a creative and technology-driven team passionate about space exploration, innovation, and problem-solving. Our goal is to transform complex space mission concepts into interactive and accessible experiences. For NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, we developed Astra Nova, an interactive Mars Mission Designer that explores spacecraft design, mission planning, resource management, and mission control. We aim to make space exploration more engaging, educational, and accessible.
summary:
Astra Nova is an interactive Mars Mission Design Simulator developed to make space exploration and mission planning more accessible and engaging.

The platform allows users to explore the process of planning a Mars mission through spacecraft design, mission control, route planning, subsystem management, power management, telemetry monitoring, and deep-space communications.

By bringing different aspects of spacecraft engineering into one interactive experience, Astra Nova aims to help users understand the complexity of interplanetary missions, the importance of resource management, and the decisions involved in operating a spacecraft.

Our project combines interactive design, educational exploration, and AI-assisted development to create an accessible introduction to the challenges of space exploration.
details:
Astra Nova is an interactive Mars mission simulator designed to make space exploration and mission planning more accessible and engaging. It features spacecraft design, route planning, mission control, telemetry, subsystem monitoring, power management and deep-space communications.

Our team worked together to conceptualise the project, plan its features, design the interface, and develop the platform using AI-assisted coding. We collaborated to bring our ideas together, refine the experience and create an interactive model that introduces users to the challenges of planning and managing a Mars mission.

Our goal is to inspire curiosity about space exploration while making complex aerospace concepts easier to explore and understand.
